questions.question: Who has more runs — Bianca Figeland or Anica Swart? (List A.)
Who holds the record for 'Most Wicketkeeping Dismissals' (combined T20 + List A)?
questions.explanation: Trisha Chetty holds it, with a total of 113.

questions.question: At Recreation Ground, who holds the record for 'Most Matches' (List A)?
At which ground did Knights record their 'Largest Win by Runs' (List A)?
questions.explanation: It was at Bloemfontein Oval — largest win by runs of 371, against Kei on 2018/11/24.

questions.question: At which ground did Anele Dilikane record their career-best bowling figures (2-7, T20)?
questions.explanation: It was at Willowmoore Park Main Oval, against Eastern Storm on 2026/03/08.

questions.question: Shabnim Ismail's first and most recent appearances in this database are separated by roughly how many years?
questions.explanation: Ismail debuted in October 2005 and was still playing as recently as March 2026, just over 20 years apart.
